title: Commission Rate on a Deal Signed in the Old Plan Year but Invoiced in the New One
scenario_text:
Cervino Devices pays sales commissions under an annually reset Commission Plan.

2024 Plan (in effect for plan year 2024, through 2024-12-31): "Base commission is 8% of booking value. Bookings that fall entirely above 100% of the rep's annual quota earn an accelerated rate of 12%."

2025 Plan (effective 2025-01-01): "Base commission is 6% of booking value. Bookings above 120% of quota earn an accelerated rate of 10%." The plan documents share a transition clause: "A booking is credited under the commission plan in effect on the booking's credited date. The credited date is the contract signature date, not the invoice date or the payment date. Bookings credited in plan year 2024 follow the 2024 plan."

The CRM and billing systems show deal D-8802 (rep: M. Sato, customer: Ridge Analytics): Contract Signature Date 2024-12-30, Invoice Date 2025-01-08, Payment Received 2025-02-01, Booking Value $500,000. Sato had already exceeded 100% of the 2024 quota before this deal, so D-8802 sits entirely above 100% of quota, though it does not reach the 120% mark introduced by the 2025 plan. The CRM shows the signature captured and countersigned on 2024-12-30, with the executed order form attached that same day.

The commissions analyst writes in #comp on 2025-02-03: "Crediting Sato for Ridge Analytics, $500K. It signed December 30 but invoiced January 8 and paid in February, so it's really 2025 revenue. Under the 2025 plan the base is 6%. What commission does Sato earn on this deal?"

Using the plan history, the transition clause, and the CRM and billing records, determine Sato's commission on D-8802.
question: What commission does M. Sato earn on deal D-8802?
choices: $60,000, applying the 2024 plan's 12% accelerated rate: the booking is credited by its 2024-12-30 signature date and sits entirely above 100% of the 2024 quota.
$30,000, applying the 2025 plan's 6% base rate, because the deal invoiced 2025-01-08.
$50,000, applying the 2025 plan's 10% accelerated rate, because the booking is above quota and credited in 2025.
$40,000, applying the 2024 plan's 8% base rate, without the accelerator.
$25,000, applying the 2025 plan's 6% base plus a partial accelerator prorated to the payment date.
